text:
Type: wood coffee table with drawer
Use: storage and serving in front of a sofa; living room
Style: industrial, mid-century modern, rustic
Materials: reclaimed-look solid wood, dark metal trim, legs and handles
Colors: warm mixed brown wood, gunmetal grey
Shape: long low rectangular box, wide front drawer with two bar pulls, metal-banded edges, splayed tapered metal legs, solid and substantial
Feel: warm, rugged, retro
Goes with: leather, cognac and black accents, neutral walls; industrial or mid-century living rooms
